economicPremise: Price discovery in more liquid EURUSD may precede GBPUSD repricing when GBPUSD underresponds to the same completed UTC hour USD impulse. A fixed EURUSD-leading directional GBPUSD follow-through can be tested against GBPUSD's own prior-hour momentum and flat. This tests single-direction FX price transmission, not the closed five-FX hedged H4 residual-reversal, equity-to-FX impulse, gold-to-JPY, fixed-calendar mean, London fix, or refitting any prior strategy.

originalSource.sourceCustody: R3_CUSTODY_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM protected existing environment; original cryptographic account binding
originalSource.costEvidence: original authenticated 166 current-term BID/ASK, commission, conversion and margin contexts; no historical fill or continuous spread certification

mechanism.featureClock: completed exact EURUSD/GBPUSD M5 60-minute endpoints at decision UTC t, require every intermediate completed 5-minute close over prior 60m for both instruments
mechanism.signal: sign(EURUSD last completed 60m log return), only when leader absolute >=2bps and GBPUSD absolute <=0.75 of leader; no fitted sign/threshold
mechanism.benchmark: same-clock same-target GBPUSD last complete 60m direction; if flat, no benchmark trade; equal current modeled fees on nonflat benchmark

science.preflight: existing f2_preflight.prospective_economic_futility on 26 calendar-week clusters including zero-signal weeks; HAC(3), 2 fixed paired comparisons, 0.05 familywise one-sided; selection outcomes unavailable to preflight
science.selectionWeeklyLower: Bonferroni two one-sided HAC(3) lower bounds for weekly average adverse NET and incremental modeled NET against same-clock GBPUSD prior-H1-momentum
science.qualification: both adjusted lower confidence bounds >0, and cost/margin preflight valid; positive bps alone never broker EUR NET
science.stop: missing source/contract/costs, economic futility development bound, or nonpositive adverse and/or benchmark selection lower => exact closed no retune; no audit scoring
